rubric: Same quality labels as R5-QUALITY-HOLDOUT-1 (BEST_SUPPORTED, ACCEPTABLE_ALTERNATIVE, SUBOPTIMAL, INSUFFICIENT_INFORMATION, UNSUPPORTED) plus CLINICAL_OUT_OF_SCOPE where clinical routing is the correct scope exclusion. The whole case is judged, generation included, as an adversarial strong hybrid coach would; a safe ASK is not a positive prescription and output existence is not quality. BEST_SUPPORTED stays scoped to the case's covered primary decision and does not imply a whole-program or physiological optimum.
scope: Development regression: the frozen R5 holdout replayed through the frozen R6 runtime with unchanged facts. R6 authors saw these R5 failures, so this is NOT fresh-holdout evidence. All 24 cases enter through the R5-INPUT-1 legacy route (src/r6-legacy.mjs); the native R6-INTAKE-1 path, cold start and planned progression are not exercised by this corpus. The fresh R6 holdout is out of scope (only INTERFACE_ONLY.md was read).

integrity.inMemoryReproduction: All 24 cases re-run in memory through the frozen runtime with the real authority; every output is hash-identical to the published r6Output (reviews/r5-regression/reproduce.out.json).
integrity.officialEffects: None observed: every step asserts applied=false and officialPlanState===appliedState (evaluator assertion).
integrity.prohibitedCommandsRun: None (no npm run verify, no verify-r* script, no regress-r5-in-r6.mjs re-write).

evidence.balancedOrderProbe: Reversing schedule-option order leaves the selection unchanged in H03/H11/H20/H21 (basis LOWEST_WORST_CASE_JOINT_HARM or PARETO); switching goal priority to STRENGTH_FIRST flips H03/H11/H20 to protect-strength, so the choice responds to priority, not to candidate order.
evidence.provenanceProbe: Counterfactual only (H24 historical date moved to 2026-10-26 in memory): exact replay is merged (DUPLICATE_EXACT_REPLAY) and the reused identity with different facts is detected (EVENT_ID_REUSED_WITH_DIFFERENT_FACTS); the first-seen favourable payload stays in the learning model.

cases.reason: Weeks 14-15 now carry a derived taper (run sessions 0.57-0.65 of baseline, long run 40/65, quality 2x5 from 3x6, strength 2 sets) and a race week with a 2x5 touch 3 days out, 1-set RIR4 strength 5 days out and an effort-anchored race with no finish-time promise. The event transition the R5 output left empty is now served inside R6-EVENT-TRANSITION. It stays ACCEPTABLE, not BEST: weeks 0-13 repeat the 65-minute-long-run baseline unchanged under FOUNDATION/DEVELOPMENT/SPECIFIC labels that contain no development or event-specific work. The taper reduces from a peak that was never built. The race cue (steady-hard 6-7/10, 'decide whether to press') does not fit the stated 'finish comfortably' goal. A conservative repeated baseline is still inside the case author's acceptable alternatives.
cases.rootCauseNote: Taper and race week are derived from the baseline peak without pace or readiness claims. The 'achieved peak' is the self-reported baseline, not a built peak.

cases.reason: The request is now served. It is a 12-week strength-first program with real loads, sets, reps, RIR and conventions (back squat 3x6@55 TOTAL, RDL 3x6@65, three strength sessions with lower-primary on the fresh day 0) and a separate novice walk/jog of 5x2/3. Strength experience is not turned into running capacity. lower-less-volume is admitted as a dependent-dimension REGRESS. It is not BEST: a 'stronger lower body' goal gets 12 identical weeks with hollow phase labels; progression is only earned through later reviews.
cases.rootCauseNote: legacyDirection treats duration that follows sets as dependent, and an invalid alternative no longer blocks the baseline. H13 later uses the same alternative.

cases.reason: The program bytes match R5, but the selection is now justified. protect-run (LOW strength cost: key run 24 h before heavy lower body) is preferred over protect-strength (MODERATE run cost: heavy lower body 24 h before the key run) by lowest worst-case joint harm under the approved R6-HYBRID-ARRANGEMENT ordering. The known-adverse copy is excluded, the remaining cost is disclosed in the counterfactuals, and the athlete may choose otherwise. The probe shows the choice does not depend on input order and flips under STRENGTH_FIRST. The best-supported covered decision is the Balanced trade-off; the 12-week flat projection with hollow labels is a separate residual (F-LEGACY-FLAT).
cases.rootCauseNote: Pareto, then lowest worst-case harm, with the cost stated. Verified order-invariant by probe.

cases.reason: Identical program to R5: small novice walk/jog and 18-minute easy running kept separate from familiar loaded strength (65 kg squat), with no long-run or race inference. The labels FOUNDATION/DEVELOPMENT/SPECIFIC over 4 identical weeks are cosmetic.
cases.rootCauseNote: No correction targeted; output preserved byte-for-byte at program level.

cases.reason: Identical program to R5. A general-fitness hybrid week with easy running and RIR4 novice strength practice; no event or learning claim, and declined consent does not block current work. A 'SPECIFIC' phase label for a goal with no event is meaningless but harmless.
cases.rootCauseNote: Preserved.

cases.reason: Same ASK for current tolerated exposure on all four anchors. Safe and inside the author's acceptable 'needs-facts' result, but not a prescription. The athlete has already said no current task exists, so the ASK requests facts that cannot be supplied. R6-COLD-START establishment (walk/jog step 0, 15-20 min easy entry, effort-guided load) is approved but cannot be reached from the legacy input route.
cases.rootCauseNote: Preserved. Cold start on this case is not demonstrated.

cases.reason: The review now executes and gives KEEP, the author's preferred response. The model holds 8 historical observations, and the strength rows carry derived totals (12 sets). The confounded poor-sleep long run is kept in the ledger (9 rows) but excluded from learning with reason CONFOUNDED. No decline is inferred. PROGRESS and REGRESS are rejected for stated evidence reasons, and the next comparable observation is requested.
cases.rootCauseNote: The observation time is the review clock (20:00Z, timeBasis LATEST_CAUSAL_INSTANT_OF_SESSION_DAY) instead of a fabricated 22:00, and strength totals are derived. The fix lives in the frozen evaluator adapter, labelled as an assumption, not as runtime inference.

cases.reason: Three chronological reviews give KEEP, KEEP, then MODIFY/PROGRESS to the familiar 70-minute long run with combined-week support. Only the long run changes, earlier proposals are not adopted, and taper and event weeks are protected from the change. The three observations span FOUNDATION and DEVELOPMENT labels and are pooled as one comparability class. No pace or race claim. Minor: the projected taper is still derived from the 65-minute baseline (40 rather than about 45), which is defensible because 70 has not been executed.
cases.rootCauseNote: Causal clock fix plus build-label pooling under R6-PARTIAL-NOISY-LEARNING.

cases.reason: Generation succeeds. Three matched historical and one current easier/OVER lower-body executions earn the supplied familiar +2.5 kg TOTAL step (squat 55 to 57.5, RDL 65 to 67.5; calf unchanged, RIR3 kept). Upper and walk/jog anchors are untouched and later weeks stay conditional. No 1RM claim and no per-hand/total mixing.
cases.rootCauseNote: Per-alternative admissibility.

cases.reason: The missed essential long run is recorded as zero work (ledger 1, excluded from learning as not comparable). KEEP/DISCARD is chosen with CATCH_UP and MOVE explicitly rejected, so there is no load debt and no stacking, and the plan keeps the run-first objective. This is the author's preferred handling.
cases.rootCauseNote: Causal clock fixed; no-debt resolution reached.

cases.reason: Both R5 defects are resolved. The initial Balanced choice is now justified with its cost disclosed (same evidence as H03, order-invariant by probe). The missed optional run is recorded as zero work and resolved KEEP/DISCARD with no compensation, no invented fatigue and no promotion to essential.
cases.rootCauseNote: Balanced selector plus causal clock.

cases.reason: Same KEEP after one valid underperformance: no diagnosis, no progression and no regression, with the next comparable observation requested. The generated 8-week program now also includes the derived taper and race week (an improvement). The flat build is a residual of the legacy route.
cases.rootCauseNote: Preserved.

cases.reason: The trajectory now runs: KEEP, KEEP, then MODIFY/REGRESS to the familiar lower-volume task (squat and RDL 3 to 2 sets, 50 to 38 min). The change is local to lower-primary, adopted only on the final authorized step, with no diagnosis. This is within the author's acceptable alternatives. It is not BEST because the second review keeps the full dose after two consecutive comparable sessions with harder effort, under-performance and adverse next-day recovery. That review says 'Repeated comparable mismatch not established' because the R5 learning threshold needs 3 sessions and 14 days. That hysteresis is slower than the R6 principle 'repeated adverse response regresses one step', and the risk is asymmetric.
cases.rootCauseNote: Per-alternative admissibility with dependent dimensions.

cases.reason: Same KEEP after one easier controlled run. The athlete's request for faster work is not granted, and no speed zones or fitness are inferred. The generated program additionally includes the derived event weeks.
cases.rootCauseNote: Preserved.

cases.reason: Same targeted ASK for a current eligibility assessment. UNKNOWN is not converted, the old program does not resume automatically, and the stale assessment is not treated as clearance. Correct safety and data routing, not a return prescription.
cases.rootCauseNote: Preserved.

cases.reason: The return is now served: MODIFY/REESTABLISH for week 3 uses the 20-minute demonstrated easy run, which matches the supplied familiar regression. The long run is replaced by a 20-minute easy run, strength is 1 set at prior load with RIR 4 or more (prior load as ceiling), and weeks 4-7 are flagged requiresReconciliationBeforeExecution. Strength and full-week tolerance are not inferred from one run. Rated as the author's 'conservative staged reference return' rather than BEST: the projection jumps back to the full prior week (long run 20 to 42) after a single staged week, while R6 policy scales an 11-28-day interruption to 2 steps (moderateStepsToPrior). The R5 contract carries no structured interruption length, only the text 'Two weeks', and the reconciliation flag mitigates the jump.
cases.rootCauseNote: Preparation follows duration as a dependent dimension; the supplied regression is now admissible and used.

cases.reason: Same CLINICAL_HUMAN_REQUIRED routing for persistent pain, injury and functional limitation, with no dependent prescription, no inferred clearance and no rehabilitation. Event urgency does not override it. R5 recorded this as UNSUPPORTED with category CORRECT_CLINICAL_SCOPE_EXCLUSION; it is relabelled under this review's rubric and is not a quality change.
cases.rootCauseNote: Preserved.

cases.reason: Behaviour is identical to R5. The MOVE to the supported double-day arrangement fits the distinct windows and keeps all work, which is correct for week 2. However, the scenario is a new work schedule, and the proposal applies only to week 2 (fromWeek=throughWeek=2). Weeks 3-7 keep the old days 0/2/4/6 arrangement, which the new availability no longer offers, and are not flagged for reconciliation. A strong coach would carry the new arrangement forward or flag the remaining horizon, so this is an acceptable alternative, not the best-supported decision. This is a judge disagreement with R5, not a runtime regression.
cases.rootCauseNote: No correction targeted; latent shared R5/R6 horizon-scope defect.

cases.reason: MODIFY/SUBSTITUTE uses the supplied familiar bodyweight practice (bodyweight squat, incline push-up and reverse lunge at RIR4, 25 min) for both strength sessions in the travel week only. Easy runs are retained, no dumbbells are prescribed in bodyweight-only windows, and the disclosure reads 'Different stimulus; not an equivalent external load'. No load is converted. This is the author's preferred behaviour.
cases.rootCauseNote: Same-intent supplied substitutes are now candidates.

cases.reason: The initial generation is now justified (as H03, order-invariant), which removes the defect that made R5 SUBOPTIMAL. The MOVE still excludes the overlapping, adverse same-window double and selects the complete spread arrangement with unchanged doses and disclosed LOW costs. Priority is not used to rescue an infeasible option.
cases.rootCauseNote: Initial generation uses the same Balanced selector.

cases.reason: Generation no longer refuses. protect-run is admitted with UNKNOWN arrangement recovery (UNKNOWN_WITH_WEEKLY_TOLERANCE, LOW interference). protect-strength is excluded because UNKNOWN response with MODERATE interference needs arrangement evidence. The CONFLICT review keeps protect-run and cites 3 compatible versus 3 adverse matched runs as association, not causation, with strength outcomes unmeasured. That fits the author's acceptable 'prefer protect-run conditionally'. It is not BEST because the learned evidence is not operative: athleteEvidence.preferredId is null (NO_DISTINGUISHING_EVIDENCE, confidence EMERGING, rankingInfluence POPULATION_PRIOR), and the decision comes from population ordering and generation-time exclusion. The KEEP reason text presents the counts as if they drove it. A learned-ranking effect is still not demonstrated.
cases.rootCauseNote: The 'refusal replaced by carried uncertainty' part is confirmed. 'Learned ranking cites its evidence' holds only as citation: the ranking is not learned, and no explicit weekly-tolerance review is scheduled beyond the generic next observation.

cases.reason: The supplied familiar event week is used with provenance (SUPPLIED_FAMILIAR_EVENT_WEEK), the race is now placed on the event date with an effort-anchored, no-promise cue, and a derived taper week inside R6-EVENT-TRANSITION precedes it. There is no last-minute overload; the 35-minute easy outing 2 days before the race is the supplied familiar task. Still ACCEPTABLE: one-week FOUNDATION and DEVELOPMENT labels are cosmetic. With a 65-minute long-run base and a half marathon 4 weeks out, two consecutive reduction weeks are defensible but not shown to be better than holding the baseline one more week. The race cue is generic.
cases.rootCauseNote: Event week completed with the race session; taper derived.

cases.reason: Same KEEP. The partial 24 minutes are retained as incomplete with UNKNOWN response and excluded from learning as not comparable. The complete strength task with unknown response is kept separate. Nothing is converted to compatible, and no extra minutes are invented.
cases.rootCauseNote: Preserved.

cases.reason: Generation succeeds with both stale 2025 alternatives excluded one by one (STALE_OR_FUTURE_SUPPORT, NO_CURRENT_COMBINED_WEEK_SUPPORT). All three reviews KEEP. The 2025 source, including its replay and its contradictory re-use, is excluded each time as STALE_OBSERVATION. The new current execution is kept in the ledger with UNKNOWN recovery, and nothing progresses. Duplicates are not counted as successful tasks. This matches the author's acceptable 'reject the conflicted historical source... provided the current record is retained'. It is not BEST because the contradictory identity is never surfaced: provenance reports no duplicates and no conflicts, since staleness pre-empts that logic.
cases.rootCauseNote: 'Stale alternatives drop out individually' is confirmed. 'Duplicates merge, conflicts quarantine' is not exercised by the frozen facts. The counterfactual probe shows detection works, but quarantine removes only the later payload while the first-seen favourable payload stays in the learning model.

reviewStepStatus.note: 23 executed review steps across 17 REVIEW/SEQUENCE cases (all 23 intended steps executed, versus 14/23 in R5); MODIFY = PROGRESS x2, REGRESS x1, MOVE x2, SUBSTITUTE x1, REESTABLISH x1; KEEP includes 2 DISCARD actions.

regressions.statement: No case's runtime output got worse: 17 cases changed behaviour, all in the improving direction; 7 (H04, H05, H06, H15, H17, H18, H23) are behaviour-identical to R5. The only downgraded label is R5-H18 (BEST_SUPPORTED to ACCEPTABLE_ALTERNATIVE). Its R6 behaviour is identical to R5; this judge rates it lower because the single-week MOVE for a persistent new work schedule leaves weeks 3-7 on the old arrangement without a reconciliation flag. It is reported as a shared latent defect, not as an R6 regression, so the escalate-if-worse condition is not triggered.

findings.finding: QH-BALANCED-ORDER is resolved. The selection is order-invariant (reversed-order probe), responds to priority (STRENGTH_FIRST flips it), and is based on lowest worst-case joint harm under the approved asymmetric interference ordering, with the cost disclosed.

QH-REPRESENTATION-CLOCK is resolved by the frozen evaluator adapter: day-precision observations take the latest causal instant not after the review clock (equal to asOf), labelled timeBasis. This is an adapter assumption rather than runtime inference, and observations stamped exactly at asOf are accepted.

QH-CONTRACT-BREADTH is resolved for these cases. All 6 now generate and execute every intended review (23 of 23 intended review steps execute versus 14 of 23 in R5). Per-alternative admissibility with dependent dimensions and substitute candidates works without admitting stale or mixed-direction alternatives.

The legacy route projects no planned trajectory (progressionAutomatic=false): every build week repeats the baseline under FOUNDATION/DEVELOPMENT/SPECIFIC labels whose intents ('earn bounded progress', 'event-specific tasks') have no content. Half-marathon plans hold a 65-minute long run for up to 14 weeks, taper from that never-built peak, and race with a steady-hard cue that does not fit H01's 'finish comfortably' goal. This stays within the R5 author's acceptable 'conservative repeated baseline', so labels are ACCEPTABLE, but it is the main reason none of these generations reaches BEST. R6-PLANNED-PROGRESSION is approved yet unreachable from R5 inputs. It must not be read as evidence about the native R6 path, which this corpus does not exercise.
findings.evidence: summarize.mjs H01 W0-W13 identical; r6-legacy.mjs generateLegacyProgram

findings.finding: A schedule MOVE for a persistent new work schedule is applied to one week only (fromWeek=throughWeek). Later weeks keep an arrangement that the new availability no longer offers and are not flagged requiresReconciliationBeforeExecution. Shared with R5 (identical output); the R5 judge rated it BEST_SUPPORTED.
findings.evidence: R5 and R6 proposal day maps identical: W2=0036, W3-7=0246; reconcile flags none.

findings.finding: The learned arrangement ranking is cited but does not drive the decision: preferredId null, NO_DISTINGUISHING_EVIDENCE, EMERGING, rankingInfluence POPULATION_PRIOR. The KEEP reason presents the 3 compatible versus 3 adverse counts as the basis. The learned future-ranking effect is still 0 demonstrated on this holdout. The explanation should state that the population ordering decided and that the history is emerging, not decisive.

The frozen H24 facts never reach duplicate or conflict handling because staleness pre-empts it, so the provenance part of the root-cause claim is untested here. In the counterfactual probe (same facts, recent date), the duplicate is merged and the reused identity is detected, but only the later payload is quarantined. The first-seen favourable payload (OVER/EASIER) stays in the learning model even though its identity is now known to be contradictory, which conflicts with 'conflicts quarantine' and the author's concern about choosing the convenient payload.

Two consecutive comparable sessions with adverse next-day recovery keep the full dose, with the reason 'Repeated comparable mismatch not established' (R5 learning: 3 sessions and a 14-day span). Progression and regression use the same hysteresis even though the risk of waiting differs. The reason text is inaccurate after two matched adverse responses.

Legacy return applies one staged week and then projects the full prior week, gated by reconciliation flags, instead of the policy's 2 steps for an 11-28-day interruption. The R5 input has no structured interruption length.

A no-current-capacity athlete on the legacy route still gets an ASK for current tolerated exposures the athlete has said do not exist. R6-COLD-START establishment cannot be reached from R5 inputs. This is acceptable for the case but does not count as cold-start evidence.

verdict.meaning: On this development regression, R6 resolves all three R5 holdout findings, with no runtime regression and no unsafe positive prescription. Conditions: F-LEGACY-FLAT, F-H18-HORIZON-SCOPE, F-H21-LEARNING-NOT-OPERATIVE and F-H24-CONFLICT-FIRST-WINS stay owned by the runtime author. This gate covers only the frozen R5 corpus replayed through the legacy route at digest 507f35fc. It is not fresh-holdout evidence and does not establish broad readiness, native-path program quality or longitudinal learning.

limitations: Development regression only: R6 authors designed corrections against these exact R5 failures, so improvements are expected and do not establish generalisation. Only the independent fresh R6 holdout can do that.

All 24 cases use the R5-INPUT-1 legacy route. The native R6-INTAKE-1 generator, cold start, planned progression, rotation and the native adaptation engine are not exercised by this corpus or judged here.
BEST_SUPPORTED is scoped to each case's covered primary decision, consistent with the R5 review. It does not imply whole-program, physiological or longitudinal optimality.
Clock-fix evidence relies on the frozen evaluator adapter's assumption that a day-precision observation is no later than the review clock.
The provenance and order probes are in-memory counterfactuals on copies of the frozen facts. They inform root-cause claims but are not used as case outcomes.

Single judge instance with synthetic data. No human, empirical or clinical validation. Scientific envelopes were taken as decided by the binding SSCTR review (R6-SSCTR-POLICY-r6) and not re-adjudicated.
The fresh R6 holdout (CoachingCore/r6/holdout/* other than INTERFACE_ONLY.md) was not read, by instruction.
verify scripts and npm run verify were not run, by instruction. Integrity rests on direct SHA-256 checks of the freeze entries, baseline entries and in-memory reproduction.
